item.title: Finding Cahawba’s past through plants
item.description: Archaeological sites are often imagined as places defined only by artifacts or ruins, but at Old Cahawba the past survives in living form as well. Trifoliate orange hedges surround our cemeteries, and daffodils bloom in clusters where flower gardens were once carefully tended.

item.title: Edmundite Missions to award $35k in grants to local business owners
item.description: The Edmundite Missions Center for Workforce Development will host its Business Institute Grant Award Presentations on Thursday, March 5, recognizing graduates of the Edmundite Missions Business Institute for Entrepreneurship and awarding small business grants to support their ventures.

item.title: Seafood & soul: Chamber welcomes Clay Seafood House with ribbon-cutting ceremony
item.description: Local foodies can now add another lunch and dinner option to their list with the recent opening of Clay Seafood House on Citizens Parkway.

item.title: Police seeking public's help to find wanted child sex offender
item.description: Police are asking for the public’s help in locating Taylor Cox, who is wanted on two felony charges of possession of child pornography.

item.title: Amari Townes’ late triples lift Southside-Selma past Whitesburg, into state championship
item.description: The Southside Panthers celebrated their first trip to the state championship game since its 1985 win with a 62-60 victory over the Whitesburg Christian Warriors on Tuesday, March 3.

item.title: Spring newcomers event is sure to be a crowd pleaser
item.description: They say that “time flies when you are having fun!” Many doubt that phrase but surely not here at your public library. Time is surely flying at record speed and we are also having a great time.

item.title: AI-Driven Security Testing: How Automation Strengthens Your Cyber Defenses
item.description: In today’s rapidly evolving digital landscape, traditional security testing methods struggle to keep pace with sophisticated cyber threats.

item.title: Southside-Selma caps historic basketball season with state finals appearance
item.description: Southside-Selma fell to Montgomery Academy in the Class 3A state championship game, but the Panthers celebrated a season full of overcoming adversity to make their first title game appearance in 41 years.

item.title: Mass Meeting at Tabernacle kicks off Jubilee
item.description: Freedom songs rang out through Historic Tabernacle Baptist Church on the evening of Thursday, March 5, before the start of the annual Mass Meeting that kicks off the Selma Bridge Crossing Jubilee.

item.title: PHOTO GALLERY: The Children's Silent Remembrance March
item.description: On this 61st anniversary of Bloody Sunday, youth of all ages crossed the Edmund Pettus Bridge during the Children's Sojourn on Friday, March 6.
